Sam Lee: Hey @Priya 10 quick heads-upb4: the open-plan on 3rd floor has been loud all week and it's triggering migraines. I have my mid-cycle review Thursday and I'm worried I won't be able to focus. Can we request a quiet room or move the time? Also curious whether this should be a formal accommodation or if interim fixes are fine.
Priya Nair: Thanks for flagging, Sam. Sorry you're dealing with that. DM me details or post here so People Ops can see. I don't want this to affect your review. We can reschedule or move to a private room.
Sam Lee: Posting here so it's tracked. Afternoons after 1pm are the worst; mornings 9-11 are usually okay. I can use noise-canceling headphones short-term but would like a repeatable solution. I also don't want coaching notes to be counted as punitive while we sort this.
Tasha Gomez: Hi Sam    thanks for raising. People Ops can start the interactive process. Interim steps we can do within 24h: reserve a focus room for your review, provide noise-canceling headphones, and work with your manager to postpone evaluative feedback. For a formal accommodation we accept a brief clinician note and will draft an ADA plan (usually 3-7 business days). Want us to submit the manager note template now?
People Ops (bot): @Sam  Ticket #HR-30921: Focus room reservation requested (Focus Room B) and 1x active noise-canceling headset ordered. ETA 1 business day.
Priya Nair: I'll move your mid-cycle review to next Friday 10:00AM in Focus Room B and mark it as developmental. Sam, would you like me to remove the self-assessment deadline for this cycle?
Sam Lee: Yes please remove the self-assessment deadline. That will help. I'll send a short clinician note when I can but please proceed with interim steps. Thank you.
People Ops (bot): Sending manager note template:
```To: Priya Nair
From: People Ops
Subject: Interim support for team member accommodation request

Priya 	 Please coordinate temporary schedule and space adjustments for Sam Lee while People Ops arranges accommodations. Treat upcoming check-ins as developmental and avoid adding performance flags related to attendance or task delays caused by the accommodation request. People Ops will follow up with formal documentation requirements if the employee requests long-term accommodation. Ticket: HR-30921
```
Priya Nair: Scheduled. I'll update 1:1 agenda to be supportive and skip any performance writeups until we have the plan in place.
Sam Lee: Really appreciate it, everyone. Feeling much better that there's a path forward :relieved:
Tasha Gomez: Noted. We'll keep this thread for tracking. Ping People Ops if anything changes.
